algorithms.name: Alert effectiveness metrics

algorithms.name: Cloud-top retrieval

algorithms.name: Observation/model/ensemble horizon blend

algorithms.name: Device-network-battery adaptive quality
algorithms.formula: quality = min(device memory, network/save-data, battery, thermal, accessibility budget)

algorithms.name: Planet execution plan compiler

algorithms.name: Bilinear grid resampling

algorithms.name: Canonical time-slice selection

algorithms.name: Revision fingerprint and classification

algorithms.name: Adaptive frame prefetch

algorithms.name: Ambiguity-aware spatial identity resolution

algorithms.name: Wildfire hotspot clustering
algorithms.formula: spatiotemporal hotspot radius grouping

algorithms.name: Density

algorithms.name: Calibrated crowd index

algorithms.name: Persistent trend
algorithms.formula: EWMA + Theil-Sen slope + persistence filter

algorithms.name: Evidence-limited scalar flow
algorithms.formula: in=max(0,delta)/dt; out=max(0,-delta)/dt

algorithms.name: Explainable crowd forecast v0

algorithms.name: Validated capacity pressure

algorithms.name: Risk hard gate

algorithms.name: Shortest path with status/capacity penalties

algorithms.name: Champion/challenger
algorithms.formula: relative MAE improvement + calibration improvement

algorithms.name: Spatiotemporal snapshot selection

algorithms.name: Digital twin capacity provenance gate

algorithms.name: Scenario isolation

algorithms.name: SCS runoff foundation

algorithms.name: Linear reservoir routing foundation
algorithms.formula: outflow=storage/K; storage+=inflow-outflow

algorithms.name: River visual semantic LOD

algorithms.name: Cross-domain Pearson association

algorithms.name: Analog feature distance

algorithms.name: Regime classifier foundation

algorithms.name: Route exposure integration
algorithms.formula: length-weighted hazard intensity with official gates

algorithms.name: Decision contribution ranking
algorithms.formula: rank absolute contribution; hard gate first

algorithms.name: Ocean vector magnitude/direction
algorithms.formula: speed=sqrt(u^2+v^2); direction=atan2(u,v)

algorithms.name: Wave visual exaggeration
algorithms.formula: display=min(cap,Hs*visualExaggeration)

algorithms.name: Deep-water swell ETA foundation

algorithms.name: Sea-level residual

algorithms.name: Provider health state
algorithms.formula: auth/schema/quota gates then freshness and failure thresholds

algorithms.name: Exponential backoff
algorithms.formula: min(max, base*2^attempt)*(1+jitter)

algorithms.name: Cost-to-value schedule
algorithms.formula: value/cost efficiency with hard safety override
guardrails: Safety-critical jobs cannot be deferred for cost

algorithms.name: Observation gap lens
algorithms.formula: observed coverage + station density + freshness + resolution + model coverage

algorithms.name: Fail-soft scene selection

algorithms.name: Job DAG topological execution
algorithms.formula: Kahn topological order over explicit dependencies

algorithms.name: Dead-letter recovery classification
algorithms.formula: retry only retryable error + idempotency + attempts < max; else quarantine

algorithms.name: Freshness SLO state

algorithms.name: Safe rollback planner

algorithms.name: Performance acceptance compiler

algorithms.name: New-engine reuse enforcement

algorithms.name: Entitlement resolution

algorithms.name: Country readiness
algorithms.formula: weighted data/license/visual/performance/QA/terrain/localization

algorithms.name: Offline trip pack selection
algorithms.formula: priority-first bounded packing with official safety override
guardrails: Official safety assets are never excluded by premium status

algorithms.name: Personal context minimization
algorithms.formula: allowlist context fields only after explicit consent

algorithms.name: Comparison semantic normalization
algorithms.formula: comparison requires same variable/unit; large resolution mismatch is disclosed

algorithms.name: Scenario entitlement gate
algorithms.formula: Control/Business + quota + no LIVE mutation

algorithms.name: Subscription state transition
algorithms.formula: explicit finite-state transition table

algorithms.name: Premium analysis cache key
algorithms.formula: feature+country+versioned user scope/context fingerprint

algorithms.name: Required launch-gate compilation
algorithms.formula: required FAIL => FAIL; else required UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN; else PASS

algorithms.name: Completion evidence gate
algorithms.formula: DONE only if engine/algorithm IDs + actual data + runtime + browser/device + tests + visual + performance + dispose + regression + no-duplicate evidence pass
guardrails: File/class/interface existence alone is never completion

algorithms.name: Secret query redaction
algorithms.formula: replace known secret query keys/values with [REDACTED]

algorithms.name: Token-bucket abuse control

algorithms.name: Launch lifecycle state machine

algorithms.name: Archive catalog time lookup

algorithms.name: Bilinear vector sampling

algorithms.name: Adaptive volume render policy

algorithms.name: Semantic label budget

algorithms.name: Semantic material grammar

algorithms.name: Skill-weighted model ensemble

algorithms.name: Local bias correction
algorithms.formula: corrected = raw - bias(location,variable,lead,regime)

algorithms.name: Semi-Lagrangian nowcast
algorithms.formula: field(t+dt)=sample(field, x-u*dt, y-v*dt)+growth-decay

algorithms.name: Evidence-backed claim gate

algorithms.name: Rain/snow phase foundation
algorithms.formula: wet-bulb + warm/cold layer depth rules

algorithms.formula: explicit rights per display/cache/history/derivative/paidAnalysis/export/apiResale/aiUse

algorithms.name: Evidence-linked report/API delivery authorization
